items.stem: Where should most data cleaning happen in a Power BI solution?

options.text: In Power Query, before the data reaches the model
options.rationale: Correct: transform data in Power Query so the model stays clean.

options.text: Manually in each visual on the report page
options.rationale: Cleaning per visual is fragile and not repeatable.

options.text: Only after publishing to the service
options.rationale: Cleaning belongs upstream, before modelling and publishing.

options.text: It is unnecessary if you write enough DAX
options.rationale: DAX cannot substitute for proper data preparation.

items.explanation: Correct: transform data in Power Query so the model stays clean.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO statements about Power BI data modelling are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: A star schema separates a fact table from related dimension tables
options.rationale: Correct: the star schema is the recommended model shape.

options.text: Relationships define how tables filter one another by cardinality and direction
options.rationale: Correct: relationships set cardinality and cross-filter direction.

options.text: A single flat table is always preferable to a star schema
options.rationale: A star schema is generally preferred over one flat table.

options.text: Relationships are unnecessary if every table is imported
options.rationale: Relationships are what let tables interact correctly.

items.explanation: Correct: the star schema is the recommended model shape.

items.stem: You need a total that responds to slicers and filters on the report. What should you create?

options.rationale: Correct: measures evaluate in the current filter context, responding to slicers.

options.text: A calculated column computed row-by-row at load
options.rationale: A calculated column does not react to report filters like a measure.
A text box does not compute a filtered total.
Adding a source does not create a responsive total.

items.explanation: Correct: measures evaluate in the current filter context, responding to slicers.
